description: An overlay that detects exploitable rule gaps and allows temporary bypasses at increasing risk.
coreLoop: Identify rule gaps during encounters.
Spend exploit charges to bend mechanics.
Manage instability to avoid system backlash.
Trigger Glitch Exploit Overlay's overlay protocol by completing a focused objective tied to your current build.
progression: Exploit tiers unlock deeper rule access.
Instability thresholds add narrative consequences.
Tier I grants a baseline passive that accelerates one progression channel while introducing a clear tradeoff.
Tier II unlocks a branch choice with mutually exclusive upgrades that force build identity.
narrativeHooks: System warnings appear when exploits accumulate.
Authority figures investigate abnormal events.
Factions notice Glitch Exploit Overlay and shift diplomacy based on your growth curve and threat profile.
questHooks: Stabilize a glitch node to regain control.
Outrun enforcement agents seeking exploiters.
Complete a category-specific trial to unlock the next Glitch Exploit Overlay milestone.
